system.description:
GRIMWARD

Some investigations have more than one monster at their centre.
You may maintain two Subjects of Inquisition simultaneously. Each Subject is tracked separately and may become Judged independently.
When you designate a third Subject, you must choose which existing Inquisition ends.
Prepared Adversary applies if either Subject qualifies, but it may still be used only once when Initiative is first rolled.

Prerequisites Level 12

Works automatically: Inquisition's Use keeps two Subjects, each with its own Judgement.
